title.zh: 英伟达推出OpenShell参考架构，为企业级AI智能体提供安全防护
title.en: 英伟达推出OpenShell参考架构，为企业级AI智能体提供安全防护

current_state.zh: NVIDIA unveiled the OpenShell reference architecture, pairing Vera Rubin infrastructure, Vera CPUs and BlueField-4 DPUs with the OpenShell secure runtime and NVIDIA Sentry to let enterprises build, run and hardware-enforce safety boundaries on large-scale AI agents, backed by Microsoft, Google Cloud, Dell, Cisco, OpenAI and Anthropic.
current_state.en: NVIDIA unveiled the OpenShell reference architecture, pairing Vera Rubin infrastructure, Vera CPUs and BlueField-4 DPUs with the OpenShell secure runtime and NVIDIA Sentry to let enterprises build, run and hardware-enforce safety boundaries on large-scale AI agents, backed by Microsoft, Google Cloud, Dell, Cisco, OpenAI and Anthropic.
